items.title: Swirling Vine Floral DXF Panel for CNC Wall Art
items.description: A single flowing vine sweeps diagonally across the panel, sprouting leaves, blossoms, and curling tendrils along its length. The asymmetrical, almost calligraphic movement of the vine gives this piece a graceful, artistic quality distinct from the more rigid symmetrical patterns in this collection.

items.title: Overlapping Islamic Star Mandala Collage Privacy Panel
items.description: An innovative architectural design featuring a multi-layered collage of traditional Islamic star mandalas in varying sizes. The overlapping geometric configurations break away from traditional grids to offer a unique, multi-dimensional texture.
